answer: By the ivory of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The spiral lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the saffron is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
